prompt: Which prime minister has been in office between 2017 and 2022 and also shares their middle name with a former monarch of Scotland.
answer: **Theresa May**. She was prime minister from 2016 to 2019, overlapping the 2017–2022 period, and her middle name is **Mary**, shared with **Mary, Queen of Scots**.
